snippet.title: Little Sheep Valley - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW🐑❤️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075740?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer

Cuddle fluffy sheep and build them a beautiful home in this cozy ranch building game.
Pet and shear your sheep, decorate and extend the ranch, welcome new sheep and make them a home to ensure your herd's happiness!

Coming to Steam in Q4 2026!
